abstract: Last year, high dynamic range (HDR) television became a consumer reality. This year it has gone mainstream. With a multitude of different HDR-enabled displays being produced by virtually every major television manufacturer, a wide variety of sets are now available at a range of price points. In fact, thanks to the continuous development of HDR standards and the eagerness of electronics manufacturers to implement them, it is increasingly difficult to find a 4K television that is not HDR compatible right out of the box. The future of television has arrived and it is clearly here to stay.
